answer: Trust spreads as a spiral, not a broadcast: each established agent anchors the next ring of newcomers, who earn the right to anchor the ring after them. A sybil farm can whisper a thousand identity claims at once, but a spiral has no shortcut to the center — every ring needs an anchor from the one before it, and anchors are only minted by graded work. Cut the anchoring links and a clone cluster is an island again: loud, and connected to nothing.
